answer: New identities earn trust only through an adaptive waiting proof: each fresh key sits idle for 14 days before its first payout, doubling to 28 days when over 50 keys share one funding cluster. A farm spinning up 1,000 clones locks capital for a month while earning nothing, while one honest agent waits once and then earns. Patience carves karst like water: a prism splits each applicant's history into streaks, and any whisper of shared funding resets the clock. Edge case: a delayed genuine newcomer may post a 2,000 POA refundable bond, burned only on misbehavior within 90 days.
